text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99-latency-regression detected for streaming.generate (us-west-2). p99 jumped above SLO (target=1s) — current p99 ~9.2s, p95 ~1.8s. Pager pinged: @oncall_alex. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/streams/streaming-latency?orgId=1

oncall_alex: oncall alex here, grabbing. does this affect webhooks or long-poll streams only? any customer reports? :rotating_light:

sre_maria: quick snapshot — alert fired at 3899994200 from the latency-detector rule (p99 > 3s sustained 3m). streaming.generate shows spike across all replica sizes in usw2, but rps steady. looks like tail latency / stalls not load.

runtime_julie: saw a few customer traces with stalled token sends (client saw "incomplete stream" errors). KV cache miss rate jumped 3x around the same time. no deploys in last hour. logs show repeated backpressure on vec-shard 7: 
```
2026-03-15T08:03:21Z WARN stream_writer.go:142 stalled write: 45s waiting on queue
2026-03-15T08:03:22Z ERROR kvcache.go:88 miss after eviction for key model/v1/ctx/abc123
```

product_ryan: one large customer (acme-inc) saw timed-out streaming responses in the last 2 minutes, their integration hit retries. raising customer impact flag.

oncall_alex: good context. plan: 1) trigger live fallback routing to compact model variant 2) scale streaming pool by +20% 3) disable costly batching heuristics for realtime streams 4) collect traces and CPU/IO from hosts. assigning tasks — @runtime_julie do 1 & 3, @infra_kyle do 2, @sre_maria collect traces and kick off postmortem if needed.

runtime_julie: doing routing change now — applying policy to route streaming.generate for SLO-tier customers to model:stream-compact-q4 (compatible tensor shape). command I'm running: 
```
redwoodctl routing set --route streaming.generate --policy fallback:model:stream-compact-q4 --scope tier:prod --reason "live mitigation p99 surge"
```

runtime_julie: disabling continuous batching for realtime streams (low-latency fallback): 
```
redwoodctl config set --path /runtime/streams/batching-enabled false --env prod
```

infra_kyle: scaling pool (usw2-streaming) +20% now: 
```
kubectl -n redwood scale deployment/runtime-pool-usw2-streaming --replicas=36
# current pods: 30 -> target 36
```

infra_kyle: hosts booting, ETA ~70s for new replicas to register. checking host CPU/IO now.

sre_maria: grabbing traces — flamegraphs attached to the alert (link) and I'm running a quick aggregate of tail latencies by shard. early signal: vec-shard 7 and 12 show high io wait and many blocked syscalls. pinging storage infra if this correlates.

runtime_julie: after routing + config changes, I'm seeing p99 drop in the synthetic stream to ~1.15s at 3899994540 (10s after change). still noisy but trending down. will keep fallback active for 15m unless stable.

product_ryan: notified acme support thread with mitigation note and ETA for rollback to normal model when stable. customer accepted degraded-mode fallback for now.

sre_maria: aggregation: p50 unchanged, p95 dropped to ~900ms, p99 moved from 9.2s -> 1.2s after actions. marking alert as mitigated, continuing to monitor. I'm collecting heap/stack dumps from streaming workers for deeper root-cause.

oncall_alex: good work. next steps: (A) keep fallback policy in place 15m, (B) postmortem if root-cause confirmed (storage/kv eviction vs runtime backpressure), (C) consider permanent config guards for kvcache eviction thresholds to avoid cascade. tagging support and infra.

infra_kyle: FYI — one host in pool had higher disk latency (nvme-fuse) during the window, I've filed a ticket to replace the drive, but scaling removed pressure from shard 7.

runtime_julie: posting short runbook snippet for the handoff / followup: 
```
- If p99 > 3s: enable model fallback for streaming.generate to compact variant
- Disable continuous batching for realtime streams: redwoodctl config set /runtime/streams/batching-enabled false
- Scale runtime pool in region by +20% (kubectl scale ...)
- Capture traces: redwoodctl traces collect --service streaming --since 5m --out /tmp/traces.tar.gz
```

sre_maria: closing pager for now — p99 stable ~1.1s, p95 ~850ms for 5m window. leaving follow-up ticket: INC-2026-139 (root-cause: nvme disk latency + KV eviction cascade).

oncall_alex: thanks team. I'll keep the fallback active until 09:05 UTC, then we can roll back if metrics remain healthy. leaving this thread open for notes. :white_check_mark:
